title: Glowing paintbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='handleGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd36b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e09b2d'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ferruleGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8eef7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9fb0c9'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='paintGrad' cx='0.4' cy='0.35' r='0.75'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fd0'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e5429f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a81e6b'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glowGrad' cx='0.5' cy='0.5' r='0.5'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3e6' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb3e6' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow halo around paint tip -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='74' r='26' fill='url(#glowGrad)'/>

  <!-- wooden handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='8' width='12' height='42' rx='6' fill='url(#handleGrad)'/>
  <rect x='44' y='8' width='4' height='42' rx='2' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='46' width='12' height='4' fill='#c9821f'/>

  <!-- ferrule -->
  <rect x='42' y='50' width='16' height='12' rx='2' fill='url(#ferruleGrad)'/>
  <rect x='42' y='53' width='16' height='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <rect x='42' y='57' width='16' height='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- bristles -->
  <path d='M42 62 Q40 70 44 76 L50 72 L56 76 Q60 70 58 62 Z' fill='#c98f5a'/>
  <path d='M45 62 Q43 69 46 73 L50 70 Z' fill='#e8b078'/>

  <!-- paint blob at the tip, glowing -->
  <path d='M44 76 Q50 70 56 76 Q58 82 53 85 Q50 88 47 85 Q42 82 44 76 Z' fill='url(#paintGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='77' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffd0ec' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M24 66 L26 72 L32 74 L26 76 L24 82 L22 76 L16 74 L22 72 Z' fill='#ffe6f6'/>
  <path d='M76 56 L77.5 60 L81.5 61.5 L77.5 63 L76 67 L74.5 63 L70.5 61.5 L74.5 60 Z' fill='#ffe6f6'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='82' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
